provenance.note: This roster is the gate's ACTUAL failures. It was believed lost: data/stage5_join_summary.json keeps only the counts (passed 242 / failed 1157) and the 225 ranked survivors, and the A16 pre-flight memo recorded 'no file on disk holds that roster'. That was wrong -- the check was scoped to this project's data/ directory, and the full row table was sitting in the carapace repo's work/ dir, where the pipeline originally ran. Same run, verified: the 225 complete ungated rows are name-identical and score-identical to survivors_ranked in the summary.
